errors.evidence: The description claims the value for 'Welt-BIP' (World GDP) rises to 3.7 in the 2010s from 3.9 in the 2000s. The chart shows a decrease, not an increase.

The description does not mention the legend or map the specific colors of the bars to their corresponding categories (Welt-BIP, Welthandel, Exporte Deutschland, Industrieproduktion Deutschland). It only vaguely states that they are 'farblich differenziert' (color-differentiated).
